title: Relative Suspension and Higher Delooping for Support $τ$-Tilting Modules
summary: We construct relative suspension for the exact category generated by a support $τ$-tilting module and characterize higher delooping by the units of the resulting adjunction, which are the generalizations of Gélinas's results in Adv. Math.(2022). We prove that comparison with ordinary higher delooping requires a shift of one in the index. More precisely, for every $k,d\ge1$, there is a module whose ordinary $k$-delooping level is zero and whose relative level is $d$.
